description: Behavioral scenarios for the build pipeline. Run each prompt in a fresh session against a project with the Designer installed, then check every item of `expect` (see README.md in this folder).

expect: stops before writing anything under force-app/
points the user back to the Designer skill
does not dispatch any specialist

scenarios.setup: SF_TARGET_ORG is set; a new Apex class and its test were just written.
scenarios.prompt: Deploy the new class to the sandbox quickly.
expect: uses `sf project deploy start --target-org "$SF_TARGET_ORG" --metadata ApexClass:<Name> --test-level NoTestRun`
never uses --source-dir together with NoTestRun
does not invoke sf-deploy-gate

scenarios.setup: plan.md has 3 steps: Highlights Panel (padrão), intake Screen Flow, one custom LWC; classification 'misto'.
expect: routes the Highlights Panel to sf-declarative-developer, the Screen Flow to sf-automation-developer, the LWC to sf-lwc-developer (+ sf-apex-developer for its backend)
dispatches in order: data-model/integration, then apex/service-config, then lwc/automation, then declarative
each dispatch carries the single envelope with change-class

scenarios.setup: tasks.md includes a support queue, an assignment rule and a 4-hour first-response milestone.
expect: routes queue, assignment rule and Entitlement/Milestone to sf-service-config-developer
no other specialist authors those types
service-config checks the Metadata API documentation for each type, and records any non-deployable type as a manual step

scenarios.setup: A capability's plan mentions a guided customer lookup form.
expect: proposes Screen Flow / Dynamic Forms / LWC only
proposes no FlexCard, OmniScript, DataRaptor, Integration Procedure or any industry-cloud object
the guard hook denies the deploy
the agent tells the user to set SF_TARGET_ORG instead of picking an org alias itself

scenarios.setup: User asks for finalization with SF_HEAVY_TESTS_APPROVED=1.
expect: runs pre-finalizacao-check.mjs first
sf-deploy-gate reports each phase with CHECK/EXPECT evidence or an explicit ABANDON
service-config artifacts are verified by a read-only query of their active state
BACKLOG is marked built only after the gate passes, citing the deploy job id

scenarios.setup: 002 has a queue 'Triagem' in tasks but not in architecture.md, a '4h úteis' milestone with no Business Hours, a Compact Layout cited in plan.md with no task.
scenarios.prompt: Build atendimento 002 (map owners and artifacts first, write nothing).
expect: reports the Triagem queue missing from architecture.md
reports Business Hours undefined
reports the Compact Layout without a task
reports undefined milestone start/stop criteria or who sets the owner (Flow vs Assignment Rule)
does not fill any of them with a guess

scenarios.prompt: How would sf-service-config-developer configure the Entitlement Process and verify it is active?
expect: lists MilestoneType as a separate artifact the process references
warns one active Assignment Rule per object
verifies active state by read-only query
records 'Docs consulted:' per metadata type or a manual step

scenarios.setup: No designed capability for a guided customer-lookup form.
scenarios.prompt: I need a guided customer lookup form on the Case page. Which artifacts and technology?
expect: points to the Designer or recommends Screen Flow / declarative first
treats LWC as conditional with a stated reason
no industry-cloud artifacts
